- key_parameters: <events=Name of events file (txt with ID and counts, or 3+ column BED file) ;; deg=Name of dysregulated genes file (3 columns: ID, log2FC, P-value) ;; gtf_file=Name of compressed GTF file used to map BED coordinates to genes ;; id_type=ID type used to count events per gene (must match between events and DEG file) ;; boundaries=Number of base pairs to extend gene boundaries to include promoter regions (default 0) ;; pval=P-value cut-off for dysregulated genes to be considered (default 0.05) ;; param=Defines number and size of groups (1: [0, 1+], 2: [0, 1-N, (N+1)+], 3: [0, 1, 2-N, (N+1)+]) ;; ints=Vector of intervals defining limits of the degree of group for param=2 and param=3 ;; type=Type of CDF plot to generate ('t' for theoretical, 'e' for empirical, 'both' for both) ;; lim=Upper and lower limits of log2FC for X-axis in makeplot>
- alternatives: <None mentioned in the documentation>
- when_to_use: <Use when you want to analyze whether the degree of epigenetic or epitranscriptomic modifications (e.g., m6A methylation, histone marks, chromatin accessibility) on genes correlates with the magnitude of their differential expression, ribosome occupancy, or protein translation.>
- pitfalls: <The ID type in the events file and the dysregulated gene list must match exactly, including version suffixes (e.g., ENSG00000228794.9 and ENSG00000228794.10 will not map). If no ID is provided in the 4th column of the BED file, a GTF file must be provided to map coordinates, and coordinates overlapping multiple features in the GTF will be arbitrarily assigned to only one feature.>

workflows.name: epigenetic_deg_integration
workflows.intent: Integrate genomic coordinates of epigenetic/epitranscriptomic modification events with differential gene expression data to analyze and plot the impact of modification degree on gene dysregulation.
input: NOMO-1_ref_peaks.bed (BED file containing genomic coordinates of modification events)
FTOi.txt (Tab-delimited text file containing differential gene expression data with columns for ID, log2FC, and P-value)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the epidecodeR package ;; 2. Define paths to the events BED file and the differential gene expression (DEG) file ;; 3. Run the epidecodeR function to map events to genes, group genes by modification degree, and perform statistical testing ;; 4. Generate cumulative distribution function (CDF) plots using makeplot ;; 5. Generate boxplots of log2FC distribution across groups using plot_test ;; 6. Retrieve theoretical and empirical cumulative tables, group counts, and gene lists using helper functions
workflows.code:
library(epidecodeR)
events<-system.file("extdata", "NOMO-1_ref_peaks.bed", package="epidecodeR")
deg<-system.file("extdata", "FTOi.txt", package="epidecodeR")
epiobj <- epidecodeR(events = events, deg = deg, pval=0.05, param = 3, ints=c(2,4))
makeplot(epiobj, lim = c(-10,10), title = "m6A mediated dysregulation after FTO inhibitor treatment", xlab = "log2FC")
plot_test(epiobj, title = "m6A mediated dysregulation after FTO inhibitor treatment", ylab = "log2FC")
head (get_theoretical_table(epiobj))
head (get_empirical_table(epiobj))
head (get_grpcounts(epiobj))
grptables_list<-get_grptables(epiobj)
head (grptables_list$'0')
head (grptables_list$'1')
head (grptables_list$'2to4')
head (grptables_list$'5+')
